verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's environment and secret-variable features (hoppscotch-docs-7, hoppscotch-docs-1) imply users can configure separate sandbox vs production environments, and self-hosting (hoppscotch-docs-14) allows full data isolation, but there is no explicit documentation describing a dedicated 'sandbox' testing workflow or safeguards preventing accidental production calls. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/production environment switching guidance, isolation guarantees, and independent confirmation that environments prevent cross-contamination.
